name: 10 Ways to Read Faster
instructions: Preview a chapter's headings and first lines before reading it fully -- your brain builds a mental map that speeds up comprehension.
Widen your peripheral vision practice by taking in 2-3 words per glance instead of reading word by word.
Reduce regression (rereading the same line) by trusting your first pass and continuing forward.
Watch today's video for ten concrete techniques to try.
